title: Ivanti Endpoint Manager AlertService Type Confusion Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Ivanti Endpoint Manager. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the AlertService. The issue results from an incorrect type cast. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise.
